question.text: A trading member's obligation regarding contract notes for derivatives trades is to:

answer.text: Issue contract notes to clients in a timely manner as part of its client-broker compliance duties
Issue contract notes only at the end of the month
Issue contract notes only when the client specifically requests one
Issue contract notes only for trades exceeding Rs. 1 lakh in value

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook includes the timely issue of contract notes within the trading member's client-broker compliance activities, and treats non-receipt of contract notes as a recognised investor complaint category. The duty therefore is to issue contract notes on a timely basis as part of standard client compliance. The Trap: Limiting contract notes to month-end, on-request, or to trades above a value threshold contradicts the compliance duty laid out in the workbook. Note: Anchor the answer to "timely issue of contract notes". Specific deadlines and prescribed contents come from separate SEBI/exchange circulars and should not be inferred from these pages alone.
